run.original_sample_description: MIMS Environmental/Metagenome sample from human gut metagenome
run.Original_Project_description: This project collected and profiled paired shotgun metagenomes and LC-MS metabolomes from subjects with inflammatory bowel disease (IBD) and non-IBD controls. We identified and validated differentially abundant (DA) features in the metagenomes and metabolomes of IBD subjects  and described putatively mechanistic associations between DA microbes  enzymes  and metabolites
